error.RESEARCH_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED: This topic only allows sources from its author-approved domains.
error.RESEARCH_URL_REJECTED: Use a public HTTPS address without credentials, ports, fragments or query text.
error.RESEARCH_SOURCE_EXISTS: This source is already in the topic's catalog.
error.RESEARCH_EXPIRY_INVALID: Choose an expiry in the future and no later than the source approval's expiry (at most one year).
error.RESEARCH_SOURCE_EXPIRED: This source approval has expired. Add it again with a new expiry to re-inspect it.
error.RESEARCH_REVIEW_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Approval needs at least one exact quote from the inspected text, all suitability checks, readable content and acknowledgement of truncation.
error.RESEARCH_RIGHTS_REQUIRED: The selected use needs a matching rights basis: excerpts need owned, licensed or public-domain rights; embeds need a video with provider metadata.
error.RESEARCH_INSPECTION_CHANGED: The inspection changed since you opened it. Refresh and review the current text.
error.RESEARCH_REVIEW_SUPERSEDED: A newer review of this source exists. Attach only the latest approved review.
error.RESEARCH_REVIEW_NOT_APPROVED: Only approved reviews can be attached.
error.RESEARCH_EPISODE_OUT_OF_SCOPE: That episode does not teach every objective of this research topic.
error.RESEARCH_ATTACHMENT_EXISTS: This reviewed source is already attached to that episode.
error.PUBLISHED_RELEASE_REQUIRED: Resources can only be attached to a published release.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: A previous request with this retry key had different content. Refresh and try again.
error.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot perform this research action.
error.YOUTUBE_SEARCH_NOT_CONFIGURED: Nothing was searched: this workspace has no YouTube key yet. The YouTube search card on this page says where to add it.
error.YOUTUBE_SEARCH_UNAUTHORIZED: YouTube refused the workspace key. Check it in AI services, under Advanced (for developers) → YouTube search key.
error.YOUTUBE_SEARCH_QUOTA: Google says this project's YouTube Data API quota for today is used up. Searches start again at {when}. To search more each day, request a higher quota in Google Cloud and then raise the daily limit here.
error.YOUTUBE_SEARCH_FAILED: YouTube search did not answer. Nothing was saved.
error.RESEARCH_SEARCH_MISMATCH: That video is not in the stored search for this topic.
error.RESEARCH_SEGMENT_OUT_OF_RANGE: The reviewed segment ends after the video does.
error.RESEARCH_SEGMENT_NOT_APPLICABLE: Only videos have a reviewed segment.
error.youtubeFailed: YouTube search failed. Nothing was saved.
error.refused: Inspection or review was refused ({reason}). Nothing was approved or delivered.
error.unavailable: The research service is unavailable. Nothing was approved or delivered.
error.YOUTUBE_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: Today's YouTube search limit for this workspace is reached, so nothing was sent. Searches start again at {when}.
error.YOUTUBE_SEARCH_RATE_LIMITED: YouTube asked to slow down. Try again in about {seconds, number} seconds.
error.YOUTUBE_SEARCH_KEY_INVALID: YouTube does not accept the workspace key (wrong, expired or deleted). An owner replaces it in AI services, under Advanced (for developers) → YouTube search key.
error.YOUTUBE_SEARCH_API_DISABLED: The key's Google Cloud project has not turned on the YouTube Data API v3, or the key is restricted from it. Enable the API for that project in Google Cloud, then check again.
error.YOUTUBE_SEARCH_TIMEOUT: YouTube did not answer in time. Nothing was saved. Try again.
